response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across various domains, including embedded systems (C/C++), but lacks direct experience with the specific requirements of embedded networking security (e.g., MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, Linux kernel modifications for security). The resume shows no mention of networking switch development, chip-vendor SDKs, or hardware control for embedded devices. Additionally, there is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency or experience with the required security technologies.
strengths: Strong C/C++ proficiency with embedded systems experience (e.g., National Instruments, LabWindows/CVI)
Diverse software development background across multiple languages and domains (web, mobile, embedded)
Experience with low-latency applications and real-time systems (e.g., Dunnhumby media)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with embedded networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)
No mention of Linux kernel modifications or security-related kernel work
Lacks native-level Japanese proficiency or clear evidence of technical communication in Japanese
